verification_approach.definition: Run python3 notes.py on a scratch notes file containing empty lines, whitespace-only lines and an indented note, and on the default notes.txt, and compare the printed output line by line with the expected numbering and text.
verification_approach.limitation: Deterministic verification for the affected behavior was unavailable: the repository has no test suite, so the evidence is the observed output of these runs.
